title: Venetian Mask - Fabric Sculpting
description: Register Here! Registration for all Aurora Cultural Centre programs is on the Town of Aurora’s e-PLAY website. All programs continue to be part of the Aurora Cultural Centre. Sunday, October 5, 2025 12:30 – 4:30 pm | Ages 16+ Aurora Town Square – Shining Hill Visual Arts Studio A 50 Victoria Street, Aurora From the museums of Venice to the living room of your home. This simple, but showy piece of art will be created in a well paced and non-rushed environment. A great introduction to get your hands exposed to liquid polymer. You can also preserve a sentimental piece of jewelry of a loved one into a work of art, or simply just make something to brag over! After completion, you can mount into a frame to display on your wall or even outdoors. Polymer liquid art work can withstand weather conditions. Note that mask shapes will be premade by the instructor and students will be sculpting fabric and adding embellishments to give it their unique and individual flair. Materials fee is $50 payable to the instructor by cash. Notes for students: Wear clothes to get dirty in. Don’t get a manicure before the class. Bring a large old light coloured 100% cotton t-shirt (or as close to 100%) with minimal logos A hairdryer with cool setting. Optional: Costume jewellery or other embelishments you wish to add to the mask to your artwork Note: Your mask will not be mounted on a canvas, but this is something you can do on your own after your mask is fully dry.
